title: Pavement Pursuit has been optimized
author: johnesco
selftext:
My project has been an experiment about "what can I produce with just vibe coding (prompts only) ?"

Claude created some tooling to help me more easy look at every micro-second of calculations in my driving game.

Tire tread marks where very cpu intensive. Once optimized, I was able to add tire marks (skids) to EVERY car in the race.

My game normally as 6 opponents. After optimizing? It can handle 100s (though not yet adding that to the game).

How has you all handled optimization in your game?

If you found Pavement Pursuit slow on your device before, how does it run now?

[http://vibecodedgames.itch.io/pavement/](http://vibecodedgames.itch.io/pavement/)

comments.author: Alienburn
comments.body: Runs good even on max settings however I find the controls hard to use and think it be easier having a throttle separate on right and perhaps two buttons for left and right on the left of the screen

replies.author: johnesco
replies.body: are you on mobile or desktop? If you are on mobile, click the gear icon, then "more" and you can pick from many control styles.
